subject.title: Feature: Auto session split when approaching context window limit

question: Should OpenClaw add a core token-pressure automatic session rollover policy, and what canonical config, handoff, idempotence, and delivery-preservation contract should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds compatibility-sensitive public session config and can affect transcript continuity, active confirmations, delivery routing, and stored session state.

options.title: Design opt-in context rollover
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved session lifecycle policy with thresholds, durable handoff state, delivery identity preservation, privacy rules, docs, and upgrade tests before implementation.

options.title: Fold into broader TTL/session lifecycle
options.body: Keep this issue open as a requirement but implement it only with the related max-age/max-turn policy so OpenClaw has one coherent rotation model.

options.title: Defer core rollover
options.body: Document compaction, memory flush, manual reset, and operator monitoring as the supported mitigations while avoiding new core session lifecycle config.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in context rollover
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved session lifecycle policy with thresholds, durable handoff state, delivery identity preservation, privacy rules, docs, and upgrade tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced daily reset and pre-compaction memory flush, and the decision spans those same session lifecycle and continuity boundaries.
